title: Robustness Evaluation of Machine Learning Models for Fault Classification and Localization In Power System Protection
abstract: arXiv:2512.15385v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The growing penetration of renewable and distributed generation is transforming power systems and challenging conventional protection schemes that rely on fixed settings and local measurements. Machine learning (ML) offers a data-driven alternative for centralized fault classification (FC) and fault localization (FL), enabling faster and more adaptive decision-making. However, practical deployment critically depends on robustness. Protection algorithms must remain reliable even when confronted with missing, noisy, or degraded sensor data. This work introduces a unified framework for systematically evaluating the robustness of ML models in power system protection. High-fidelity EMT simulations are used to model realistic degradation scenarios, including sensor outages, reduced sampling rates, and transient communication losses. translated_title: 电力系统保护中用于故障分类与定位的机器学习模型鲁棒性评估
translated_abstract: 可再生能源和分布式发电的日益渗透正在改变电力系统，并使依赖固定整定值和本地测量的传统保护方案面临挑战。机器学习（ML）为集中式故障分类（FC）和故障定位（FL）提供了数据驱动的替代方案，能够实现更快、更具适应性的决策。然而，实际部署在很大程度上取决于鲁棒性。保护算法即使在面临缺失、含噪声或退化的传感器数据时也必须保持可靠。这项工作引入了一个统一框架，用于系统性地评估电力系统保护中机器学习模型的鲁棒性。该框架利用高保真电磁暂态（EMT）仿真来模拟真实的退化场景，包括传感器中断、采样率降低和瞬时通信丢失。该框架为模型基准测试提供了一致的方法，量化了受限数据的影�响……
tldr: 本文提出了一个统一评估框架，利用高保真EMT仿真系统性地评估电力系统保护中机器学习故障分类与定位模型在传感器中断、采样率降低和通信丢失等数据退化场景下的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a unified framework that uses high-fidelity EMT simulations to systematically evaluate the robustness of machine learning models for fault classification and localization in power system protection under realistic data degradation scenarios such as sensor outages, reduced sampling rates, and transient communication losses.
